dct_title_s: Plan of Center Pier Lovelandtown Road Bridge Over Bayhead-Manasquan Canal
dct_description_sm: Map covers area from Bridge Tender's House to Rest Pier in Point Pleasant Borough. Map shows plans for the Center Pivot Pier and includes a wax-paper overlay with more specific details for the pier.
